title: Google Flights Cheapest Dates Scraper
description: Find Google Flights’ cheapest date-range option for airport routes with price, airline, stops, duration, and itinerary legs. Batch routes and choose a future search window.

routes.title: Airport routes
routes.description: Origin and destination airport codes to compare for the same date range.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin airport code for the route or destination search.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: KAYAK destination code for the vacation-package search.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult travelers included in the search.

children.title: Children
children.description: Number of children traveling on the cruise search.

infants_in_seat.title: Infants In Seat
infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants in seat (0-9, default: 0)

infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap
infants_on_lap.description: Number of infants on lap (0-9, default: 0)

cabin_class.title: Cabin Class
cabin_class.description: Cabin class: economy, premium_economy, business, or first (default: economy) Accepted values: economy, premium_economy, business, first.

exclude_basic.title: Exclude Basic
exclude_basic.description: Exclude basic economy fares when searching in economy class (default: false)

max_stops.title: Max Stops
max_stops.description: Maximum stops: any, nonstop, one_or_fewer, or two_or_fewer (default: any) Accepted values: any, nonstop, one_or_fewer, two_or_fewer.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code for prices (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

outbound_times.title: Outbound Times
outbound_times.description: Outbound time window as comma-separated hours, e.g. "6,18" for departures between 06:00 and 18:00. Two further values narrow the arrival window.

bags.title: Bags
bags.description: Carry-on bag count. Only 0 is currently supported. Accepted values: 0. Allowed values: 0.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: Value accepted by the Google Flights Cheapest Dates Scraper search. Accepted values: 2. Allowed values: 2.

from_date.title: From Date
from_date.description: Start of date range in Y-m-d format When omitted, the start date is set to 30 days from today.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: End of date range in Y-m-d format When omitted, the end date is set to seven days after the start date.

trip_duration.title: Trip Duration
trip_duration.description: Duration of trip in days (1-30, default: 7)
